import datetime
import humanize
from datetime import timedelta

# Test R3: Very large time deltas
print('Testing R3 - large time deltas:')

# Very large delta
huge_delta = timedelta(days=999999999)  # ~2.7 million years
result1 = humanize.naturaldelta(huge_delta)
print(f'naturaldelta(huge_delta) = {repr(result1)}')

# Even larger
very_huge = timedelta(days=999999999999)  # ~2.7 billion years
try:
    result2 = humanize.naturaldelta(very_huge)
    print(f'naturaldelta(very_huge) = {repr(result2)}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'naturaldelta(very_huge) raised: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

# Test with timedelta.max
try:
    result3 = humanize.naturaldelta(timedelta.max)
    print(f'naturaldelta(timedelta.max) = {repr(result3)}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'naturaldelta(timedelta.max) raised: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

# Test naturaltime with large delta
try:
    result4 = humanize.naturaltime(huge_delta)
    print(f'naturaltime(huge_delta) = {repr(result4)}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'naturaltime(huge_delta) raised: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

# Test negative large delta
neg_huge = -huge_delta
try:
    result5 = humanize.naturaldelta(neg_huge)
    print(f'naturaldelta(neg_huge) = {repr(result5)}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'naturaldelta(neg_huge) raised: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
"
